_comment: Copy to sources.json and edit. Each source becomes ONE markdown file in out/ plus one entry in out/manifest.partial.json (schema matches ../s3-ingest/manifest.json). 'url' + 'fileName' are required; the rest inherit from 'defaults'. sourceType in AGENCY_GUIDELINE | INTERNAL_POLICY | INVESTOR_OVERLAY | EDUCATIONAL. See README for the regulatory-corpus caveat: prefer official published files for Fannie/Freddie/HUD; use crawling for your own docs + educational/explainer content.

sources._note: INTERNAL_POLICY entries must point at a PUBLIC page. Do NOT point at the suite console (suite.example.com) — it is a Cognito-gated SPA with no crawlable help pages; the crawler would get an auth wall / empty render. For internal how-to content, author markdown into a pack corpus directly instead of crawling.
